summary: KB: faster import and incremental refresh from a snapshot
description:
Source: KB review 2026-11-04 (P5, P6).

* **Faster import:** build the HNSW index after the bulk load, not before (`ensure_schema` creates it first today). Use larger or parallel embedding batches (64 today, sequential).
* **Incremental refresh:** the crawl cursor lives in a local `.cache/kb-crawl-state.json`. Store the per-project cursor in the snapshot manifest, so `kb update` = import the snapshot, then crawl only what changed since.

**Acceptance:** import time measured before and after; `kb update` on a fresh machine fetches only post-snapshot items.

comments.body: DFMEA 2026-11-04 (F13) raises leak-guard rigor. Checked on main: the time guard from ANVIL-43 already exists (`make_kb_search(as_of)`, host-side), and acceptance checks are uploaded only after the agent finishes. The real gap is this ticket: undated documents (rtems-docs, Confluence) escape the time guard. Its other idea, semantic-similarity screening of withheld patches, is noted as a post-demo option here, not a separate ticket.
